name: whatsapp-business
description: Send messages and manage templates, contacts, and phone numbers in WhatsApp Business.

WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID.title: WhatsApp Business Account ID
WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Shown next to your account name in WhatsApp Manager.

WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.title: Phone number ID
WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.description: The long numeric ID under Account tools > Phone numbers in WhatsApp Manager, not the phone number itself.

WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Access token
WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A system user token with the whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions.
